title: The Times reports on Chris Bogart's comments regarding the YPF decision
summary: The Times comments on CEO Chris Bogart’s recent comments following the YPF decision. As reported: “Christopher Bogart, the Burford chief executive, told reporters in London this week that, because the company had sold a stake in the two-part litigation, [it] hard turned a handy profit," while also predicting the claim would ultimately be resolved via arbitration. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*The Times* reports on CEO[Chris Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) ’s recent comments following the YPF decision.


As reported: “Christopher Bogart, the Burford chief executive, told reporters in London this week that, because the company had sold a stake in the two-part litigation, \[it\] hard turned a handy profit," while also predicting the claim would ultimately be resolved via arbitration.


Read the full article[here](https://www.thetimes.com/uk/law/article/litigation-funder-boasts-of-100m-profit-despite-court-loss-r97hc2m6t) .
